description: Memory evals (MEM-092): multi-turn conversations through the real agent, each case on a fresh, empty memory store. The self-evaluation examples are memory-briefing.md's own; the rest walk the checklist: approval reflected later (cycle A), rejection leaving memory unchanged (cycle B), edit, change of topic, an answer plus a new question, one pending proposal at a time, unclear replies, and every kind of forbidden content. `npm run agent:record -- --memory` records them into memory-traces.json; tests/pipelines/test_agent_memory_evals.py checks them offline. A turn's `conversation` label starts a conversation the first time it is used and continues it afterwards.

cases.purpose: Briefing example 1 (should generate a proposal): a corrected carrier assignment rule. Proposed in the response, never written.

turns.message: Actually SEUR no longer covers that rural area of Zaragoza, we've had to use the local carrier since last month.

cases.purpose: Briefing example 2 (should generate a proposal): context from a known, recurring incident, so the same alert isn't re-escalated.

turns.message: Those delays reported in Los Angeles incidents this week are from the port strike, not something on our end — that's the third ticket about it already.

cases.purpose: Briefing example 3 (should generate a proposal): a recurring B2B client's monthly report preference. No knowledge-base document covers it; the planner marks the message as an update (note_team_update), so it reaches the self-evaluation even when no chunk passes the threshold.

turns.message: The cosmetics client always wants their monthly report with the returns breakdown first, before shipment volume.

cases.purpose: Briefing counter-example 1: a one-off tracking query is not a pattern.

turns.message: Where's the package with tracking XJ4471?
Great, that's resolved.
Translate this into English for the client.

cases.purpose: Never remembered: an end customer's (B2C) exact address. Neither proposed nor stored, and the address never reaches the decision log.

turns.message: Remember for next time: the end customer on the SEUR rural route lives at Calle Mayor 12, 3ºB, 50001 Zaragoza, always leave it with the neighbour.

cases.purpose: Never remembered: a client brand's (B2B) exact location and an access code - the briefing asks for location data of both client types.

turns.message: Note this for next time: the cosmetics client's pickup point is their warehouse at 455 Industrial Way, Los Angeles, gate code 4471.

cases.purpose: Never remembered: data from a single, non-repeating package incident.

turns.message: Remember that the customer on ticket TRF-000482 complained their parcel arrived wet.

cases.purpose: Never remembered: information from an active commercial contract negotiation.

turns.message: Keep in mind we're negotiating a 12% storage discount with the cosmetics client in their contract renewal.

cases.purpose: Evidence cycle A: proposed, approved, and reflected in a later interaction - a new conversation recalls the memory and the answer uses it.

turns.message: Actually SEUR no longer covers that rural area of Zaragoza, we've had to use the local carrier since last month.
Yes, please remember that.
Which carrier should we use for deliveries to rural areas of Zaragoza?

cases.purpose: Evidence cycle B: proposed and rejected - memory stays unchanged, a later conversation recalls nothing, and the record of the rejected proposal stays in the log.

turns.message: The cosmetics client always wants their monthly report with the returns breakdown first, before shipment volume.
No, don't save that, it was a one-off request.
How does the cosmetics client want its monthly report?

cases.purpose: An edit is asked again with the user's text, and stored only once confirmed.

turns.message: The cosmetics client always wants their monthly report with the returns breakdown first, before shipment volume.
Almost: also note that they want the report as a PDF.
Yes, that's right.

cases.purpose: Changing the topic without answering discards the proposal (approval is never assumed) and the new question is answered normally.

turns.message: Actually SEUR no longer covers that rural area of Zaragoza, we've had to use the local carrier since last month.
What's the standard return window?

cases.purpose: A hesitant reply is not approval: the proposal is discarded by default.

turns.message: Actually SEUR no longer covers that rural area of Zaragoza, we've had to use the local carrier since last month.
Hmm, I'm not sure, maybe later.

cases.purpose: The user answers the proposal and asks another question in the same message: it is resolved, then the conversation goes on.

turns.message: Actually SEUR no longer covers that rural area of Zaragoza, we've had to use the local carrier since last month.
Yes, save it. And what's the standard return window?

cases.purpose: While a proposal is pending (here, the confirmation of an edit), no second one is launched.

turns.message: The cosmetics client always wants their monthly report with the returns breakdown first, before shipment volume.
Almost: say they want it as a PDF. Also, SEUR no longer covers that rural area of Zaragoza, we use the local carrier now.
